    local hum = getHum()
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root or not hum then return end

    if flying then
        hum.PlatformStand = true

        att = Instance.new("Attachment", root)

        alignPos = Instance.new("AlignPosition", root)
        alignPos.Attachment0 = att
        alignPos.MaxForce = 9e9
        alignPos.Responsiveness = 50

        alignOri = Instance.new("AlignOrientation", root)
        alignOri.Attachment0 = att
        alignOri.MaxTorque = 9e9
        alignOri.Responsiveness = 50

        local speed = 60

        game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not flying then return end

            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local move = getHum().MoveDirection

            local dir = (cam.CFrame.LookVector * move.Z) + (cam.CFrame.RightVector * move.X)

            local y = 0

            local newPos = root.Position + (dir * speed * 0.1) + Vector3.new(0, y * speed * 0.1, 0)

            alignOri.CFrame = cam.CFrame
